messages.content: What is 2 plus 3? Reply with one number.
Note: The blue bag is on the chair. Where is the blue bag? Answer in a short phrase.
Note: Rumi owns the silver key. Who owns the key? Reply with the name only.
Say hello in one short sentence.
Note: Our meeting is on Monday. Which day is it?
Correction: the meeting is on Tuesday. Give only the updated day.
My preferred drink is tea. What drink do I prefer?
I now prefer water. What drink do I prefer now?
Help me plan a trip. Ask one question first.
Where would you like to go?
Note: A parcel arrived today. Who sent it? Use only the note.
